ExactSentence: 授权第二版 T0 演练：按独立审查列出的条件修订监督程序，运行前先审查并把确切字节提交绑定，再由所有者以管理员身份运行一次安装器、运行一次监督下的清单探测。不接受资产、不生成 Manifest、不正式运行、不关闭 DSP-004；不改动系统审计策略。
SentenceOrigin: The recorder described the v2 plan (move supervisor/probe/list into the admin-protected folder, absolute host path, outside-in module enumeration, cleared environment, token/UAC record, post-run scan and per-file ACL, a further independent review; owner runs an elevated step and one launcher) and said it needs re-authorization and the owner decides. The owner replied: 继续。 The recorder wrote this sentence to capture that plan; the owner did not write it word for word. Changing the system audit policy was not described as part of the plan and is excluded.

Supersedes.PriorSentence: 授权按 OD04-A 推进三步：①由所有者以管理员身份运行记录人提供的脚本，建立专用运行时目录并设置访问控制；②由记录人编写外层监督程序，审查后绑定其 SHA；③用监督程序做一次只跑清单探测的 T0 演练。不接受资产、不生成 Manifest、不正式运行、不关闭 DSP-004。
Supersedes.RelationNote: REV3's single dry run was used (REV23). REV4 authorizes one v2 install and one v2 dry run. Every exclusion stays.
